items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: We only had a six piece lineup. Earl Hines, Donnell Howard, Ed Garlin, myself.

ctx.x: Well things that got kind of tough with me around 1955, Doc was getting up a house band. Well he had, what's his bass player, he used to play with Ori. Barlin Burden.

items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1960-03-16
items.q: Well, when I was with them, it was Earl Hines, Donnell Howard, Ed Garland, and what's this white trumpet player's name? Muggsy?

ctx.x: Who else was in the band?
